_comment: FM-1 pre-migration snapshot lock for BL-FRESH-YES-OBLIG.
_shift_notes_S77e_step4: Classification (i) FIXTURE-WAS-WRONG — hand-written BL_FRESH_YES_OBLIG.payload carried: (a) urgencyLevel:'STANDARD' / existingBankRelationship:'YES' (invalid enum values — dropped); (b) businessIndustrySector:'Trading' (case-mismatched — current V2 schema uses lowercase 'trading'); (c) businessVintage:'3-5yr' (current V2: '3_to_5'); (d) gstRegistrationStatus:'REGISTERED' (current V2: 'registered'); (e) annualTurnoverRange:'1CR_5CR' (current V2: '1cr_to_5cr'); (f) numberOfEmployees:'11_50' (current V2: '6_to_20'); (g) businessEntityType:'Proprietorship' (current V2: 'proprietorship'). Note: businessEntityType/businessIndustrySector/businessVintage/gstRegistrationStatus/annualTurnoverRange/numberOfEmployees are loanRequirementPage (sic — businessProfilePage) loan-level answers, not applicant-level; applicantPayload.ts branch only surfaces them on the applicant if rawApplicant has them. The journey sets them on the BUSINESS profile PAGE (loan-level), so they don't appear on the applicant payload at all. The hand-written scenario's copies on the applicant object were both wrong shape AND wrong values — corrected snapshot simply omits them from the applicant. applicantPayload.ts gstRegistrationDate source is applicant.GSTRegistrationYear, surfaces unchanged.
